title: desmodium fruticulosum
intro: Desmodium fruticulosum, commonly known as Finger-herb or Finger-herb Desmodium, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium fruticulosum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit bronchodilatory effects, making it a potential treatment for respiratory conditions like asthma. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium fruticulosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
